# Pinterest Russia

> > Visual discovery and inspiration platform featuring diverse creative content from crafts and recipes to character design and cultural traditions.

Pinterest Russia (ru.pinterest.com) serves Russian-speaking users with curated collections of ideas spanning international cuisines (Georgian Khachapuri), craft projects (Hello Kitty amigurumi, paper toys), fan art (Hollow Knight), traditional crafts (knitting techniques), and multilingual content including Uzbek imagery. The platform enables users to discover, save, and organize visual inspiration across creative, culinary, and cultural domains.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest Ideas Collections
- Georgian Cuisine (Khachapuri, Adjarian)
- Craft Projects & DIY
- Hello Kitty & My Melody
- Amigurumi & Beading
- Paper Toys & Printables
- Hollow Knight Fan Art
- Knitting & Crochet Patterns
- Uzbek Content (Ғамгин расмлар)
- Character Design
- Food Inspiration
- Kids Crafts (Ages 5-10)
- Digital Downloads
- Cultural Traditions

## Food & Recipe Inspiration

- [Аджарские Хачапури](https://ru.pinterest.com/ideas/аджарские-хачапури/953623748253/): Georgian Adjarian Khachapuri cheese bread recipe ideas collection

- [Амигуруми Из Бисера Схемы Хеллоу Китти](https://ru.pinterest.com/ideas/амигуруми-из-бисера-схемы-хеллоу-китти/953092325418/): Hello Kitty beaded amigurumi patterns and craft schemes

## Knitting & Textile Arts

- [Кетлевка горловины в карман](https://ru.pinterest.com/hudjakov01/кетлевка-горловины-в-карман/): Knitting neckline and pocket techniques board with 32 ideas
